analysis: Uniform averaging over all non-padding target positions achieved host validation macro HR@10 of 0.5137, up from 0.5062 with recency weighting (+0.0075). Electronics improved from 0.375 to 0.410. Per-category HR@10 was Movies_and_TV 0.575, Industrial_and_Scientific 0.560, Electronics 0.410, and CDs_and_Vinyl 0.510. The result matches the historical uniform-loss score and supports retaining older-transition supervision in this configuration; it does not establish causality or held-out performance.
code_summary: Per-category SASRec models use 64-dimensional item and learned position embeddings, two causal Transformer blocks with two attention heads, dropout 0.2, maximum history length 128, and learned item biases. Training uses positive-plus-64-negative cross-entropy, now averaged uniformly across valid positions, with AdamW and validation checkpoint selection. Architecture, sampling, dataset routing, runtime controls, and predictor writer remain unchanged.
